name: juro-platform
description: JURO LegalTech monorepo: public website and user platform

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/platform ci && npm --prefix apps/website ci
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/website run lint && npm --prefix apps/platform run lint
scripts.type-check: npm --prefix apps/website run type-check && npm --prefix apps/platform run type-check && npm --prefix apps/admin run type-check
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/website run build && npm --prefix apps/platform run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/website test && npm --prefix apps/platform test
